newsitem.title: UK: Conoco UK refinery to shut for six week maintenancE.
newsitem.headline: Conoco UK refinery to shut for six week maintenancE.

text.p: Conoco Ltd's east coast UK refinery at Immingham will shut for six weeks from May 3 for planned maintenance, the company said on Monday.
The refinery typically processes about 150,000 barrels per day (bpd) of light sweet crude and 50,000 bpd of straight run atmospheric residue.
The plant exports up to 1.5 million barrels a month of gasoline to the United States and the same amount of gas oil to Europe.
A complete shutdown of this type happens at the refinery in "excess of every five years" a spokesman said. Conoco, is the energy subsiduary of DuPont Co.
